supply_line.intro.en: Commander, the frontier towns have gone silent. Helix has cut the relief road. Escort our supplies through the three checkpoints. These trucks are their lifeline.
supply_line.intro.zh_CN: 指挥官，边境城镇失去了联系。螺旋封锁了救援道路。护送补给车通过三个检查点。这些物资是居民的生命线。

supply_line.checkpoint.en: The first checkpoint is clear. Our scouts found a damaged command relay ahead. Keep the convoy together. We will need those supplies to bring it online.
supply_line.checkpoint.zh_CN: 第一个检查点已畅通。侦察发现前方的指挥中继受损。保持车队集结，我们需要这些物资恢复通信。

supply_line.victory.en: The supplies are safe. The towns can hold on. Now restore the command relay, and find out why Helix is mobilizing across the frontier.
supply_line.victory.zh_CN: 补给已安全送达。城镇暂时脱离危险。现在恢复指挥中继，查明螺旋为何在边境大规模动员。

first_orders.intro.en: The convoy bought us time. This relay can reconnect the frontier, but Helix is listening. Build your command lab, program your support units, and secure the relay with infantry.
first_orders.intro.zh_CN: 车队为我们争取了时间。这个中继能重新连接边境，但螺旋正在监听。建造指挥实验室，为支援单位编程，再用步兵夺取中继。

first_orders.lab.en: Command is online. Your units can now follow a shared doctrine. Give your tanks a safe retreat point, and let repair crews keep them in the fight.
first_orders.lab.zh_CN: 指挥系统已上线。部队现在可以执行统一战术。为坦克设置安全撤退点，让维修部队持续提供支援。

first_orders.relay.en: We have a signal. Helix factories are receiving orders from a central command network. Hold this relay while we trace the transmission.
first_orders.relay.zh_CN: 信号已接通。螺旋工厂正在接收中央指挥网络的命令。守住中继，我们正在追踪信号。

first_orders.victory.en: The trace leads to three relay stations. Helix is using them to coordinate its forces. Split your formation, seize the network, and break their advantage.
first_orders.victory.zh_CN: 追踪指向三座中继站。螺旋利用它们协调部队。分配阵型，夺取网络，打破敌军的优势。

split_signal.intro.en: This is the network junction. One relay is not enough. Capture at least two with infantry and hold them together. Your repair crews must move with the line.
split_signal.intro.zh_CN: 这里是网络枢纽。只夺取一座中继还不够。用步兵同时控制至少两座，维修部队必须跟随战线前进。

split_signal.network.en: Two relays are transmitting. We intercepted an evacuation request from engineers trapped beyond the air corridor. Keep the network open until their coordinates are confirmed.
split_signal.network.zh_CN: 两座中继已开始传输。我们截获了被困工程师从空中走廊发出的撤离请求。保持网络畅通，直到确认他们的位置。

split_signal.victory.en: We have the engineers location. Helix anti-air batteries cover their escape route. Clear those batteries and escort the rescue flights out.
split_signal.victory.zh_CN: 工程师的位置已确认。螺旋防空炮控制着撤离航线。摧毁防空炮，护送救援航班撤离。

air_corridor.intro.en: Our engineers are waiting for extraction. Ground forces must silence both anti-air batteries before the rescue flights launch. Screen the corridor against enemy aircraft.
air_corridor.intro.zh_CN: 工程师正等待撤离。地面部队必须先摧毁两座防空炮，救援航班才能起飞。守住走廊，拦截敌机。

air_corridor.batteries.en: The batteries are silent. Launch when your escort is ready. Every engineer we save brings us closer to stopping the foundry behind this offensive.
air_corridor.batteries.zh_CN: 防空炮已被摧毁。护航部队准备好后再发起撤离。每救出一名工程师，就离阻止这场攻势背后的铸造厂更近一步。

air_corridor.flight.en: The first flight is clear. The rescued engineers confirm that Helix is building an armored force at the old foundry. Protect the remaining flights.
air_corridor.flight.zh_CN: 第一架航班已安全撤离。获救工程师确认，螺旋正在旧铸造厂组建装甲部队。保护剩余的航班。

air_corridor.victory.en: The engineers are safe. They have marked the foundry production nodes for us. Disable the factories before another armored formation reaches the towns.
air_corridor.victory.zh_CN: 工程师已安全撤离。他们为我们标出了铸造厂的生产节点。在新的装甲部队抵达城镇前，让工厂停止运转。

broken_foundry.intro.en: The foundry is still producing armor. Destroy both production nodes, then send infantry to secure its control station. Strike the factories, or their reinforcements will wear you down.
broken_foundry.intro.zh_CN: 铸造厂仍在生产装甲车辆。摧毁两个生产节点，再用步兵控制操作站。先攻击工厂，否则增援会不断消耗你的部队。

broken_foundry.node.en: One production node is down. The second factory is still active. Keep your armor repaired and prevent its reinforcements from joining the defenders.
broken_foundry.node.zh_CN: 一个生产节点已停止运转。另一座工厂仍在运行。及时维修装甲部队，阻止增援与守军会合。

broken_foundry.control.en: Both factories are disabled. Secure the control station with infantry. Its archives will reveal the location of Helix central command.
broken_foundry.control.zh_CN: 两座工厂都已停止运转。用步兵控制操作站，其中的档案将揭示螺旋中央指挥部的位置。

broken_foundry.victory.en: The foundry is ours. Central command lies beyond the eastern ridge. This is our chance to end the offensive. Secure deployment, then take the command base.
broken_foundry.victory.zh_CN: 铸造厂已被控制。中央指挥部就在东侧山脊之外。这是终结攻势的机会。先建立部署区，再进攻指挥基地。

command_horizon.intro.en: We have reached Helix central command. Establish a guarded deployment zone, then advance on its headquarters. Their base is active. Destroy its production and keep your support protected.
command_horizon.intro.zh_CN: 我们已抵达螺旋中央指挥部。先建立有人驻守的部署区，再进攻总部。敌军基地仍在运行。摧毁生产设施，保护支援单位。

command_horizon.deployment.en: Deployment is secure. Leave infantry on the control point while the strike force advances. The towns are counting on us to silence this command network.
command_horizon.deployment.zh_CN: 部署区已建立。让步兵留守控制点，突击部队继续前进。城镇居民正等待我们关闭这个指挥网络。

command_horizon.command.en: Their headquarters is down. Finish the siege commander, and keep the deployment guard in place. We cannot leave an organized force behind.
command_horizon.command.zh_CN: 敌军总部已被摧毁。消灭攻城指挥官，并保持部署区有人驻守。我们不能留下仍有组织的敌军。

command_horizon.victory.en: The command network is silent. The relief road is open, the engineers are home, and the frontier can rebuild. Good work, Commander. Our people have a future again.
command_horizon.victory.zh_CN: 指挥网络已停止运转。救援道路畅通，工程师平安归来，边境可以重建了。指挥官，任务完成。我们的人民重新拥有了未来。

common.defeat.en: We have lost this position. Fall back and regroup. Review the enemy approaches, keep repair support close, and return when your formation is ready.
common.defeat.zh_CN: 我们失去了这个阵地。撤退并重新集结。检查敌军的进攻路线，保持维修支援，整备阵型后再来。

common.enemy_base.en: Enemy factories are active. Their reinforcements come from a working base. Destroy production, or intercept the units as they leave the factory.
common.enemy_base.zh_CN: 敌军工厂正在运行。增援来自实际运作的基地。摧毁生产设施，或在单位离开工厂时拦截它们。

common.boss_arrives.en: Helix has committed its siege commander. Its heavy gun marks a position before firing. Move out of the target zone, keep repairs behind your screen, then counterattack.
common.boss_arrives.zh_CN: 螺旋已投入攻城指挥官。它的重炮会在开火前标记位置。离开目标区，让维修部队留在掩护后方，再发起反击。

common.boss_defeated.en: The siege commander is destroyed. Keep infantry at deployment and finish the command headquarters. The network will collapse when both are secured.
common.boss_defeated.zh_CN: 攻城指挥官已被摧毁。保持部署区有步兵驻守，并摧毁指挥总部。两项目标完成后，网络就会崩溃。
